flip.description: How the plate is turned over, default from the profile.

drill_map.description: Which drill is used for holes without a drill of their own size: hole diameter in mm (as text) to the diameter of a drill of the tool library. The holes are drilled together with that drill's own holes. An unknown drill is refused (`mill.invalid_drill_map`).

marks.description: Positioning marks. The one at the lower left after turning the plate becomes X0 Y0 of all programs, the other one is named in the program headers and in programs.json.
